title.narrative: Improving health care for people living in South Sudan
Verbesserung der Gesundheitsversorgung für die Bevölkerung im Südsudan

description.narrative: Die Versorgung mit Gesundheitseinrichtungen hängt im Südsudan in hohem Maße von externen Geldgebern ab. Nur 20 % der Gesundheitsversorgung werden von lokalen Anbietern geleistet und der südsudanesische Staat investiert lediglich 2 % des nationalen Budgets in Gesundheit. The provision of healthcare facilities in South Sudan is highly dependent on external donors. Only 20 % of healthcare is provided by local providers and the South Sudanese state only invests 2 % of the national budget in health. The health situation of many people is catastrophic, with maternal and child mortality rates in particular being among the highest in the world. The aim of the project is to improve healthcare for the population in the catchment area by providing services in a central hospital.
